column1: # models.registry.tsv - the concept generation feature's model picker
# HAND-CURATED. Which locked weight plays which part, and with which
# workflow family. models.lock (generated, 8 columns, refused by
# hf_download.py if a column is added) stays the source of hashes; this
# file is joined to it by `file` and says what a row IS so the studio's
# model / LoRA picker can list only what fits the step it is on: a
# Z-Image workflow cannot load a Qwen checkpoint, and ComfyUI would only
#   file             dest_filename in models.lock (the join key)
#   family           zimage | qwen-edit | wan | wan14b - the workflow stack it plugs into
#                    (wan = the 5B line; wan14b = the A14B two-expert line, whose
#   role             checkpoint | lora | controlnet | te | vae
#   trigger          a LoRA's trigger phrase ("-" for none)
#   default_strength a LoRA's default strength ("-" for none)
# A file listed here but absent from models.lock is shown as unlocked; one
# in the lock but not here is not offered. `GET /models?probe=1` marks
# each row installed or not from ComfyUI's own file lists.

column4: Pixel-Art master (prithivMLmods; not installed, see models.lock)
